world.title: The Kamau Will
world.subtitle: Power. Family. Truth.
world.seasonQuestion: What does justice look like when the crime built an empire?
world.premise: Industrialist Elias Kamau dies and leaves his 51% controlling stake to Amara Otieno, a 26-year-old primary-school teacher his family has never met. His first private letter to Amara says her father built the company—and Elias stole it from him.
